body:
BATCH HANDOFF — 4 daily-driver UX papercuts/features filed by the product seat this session (2026-06-25), all from real operator friction at the keyboard. Theme: "make the surface not janky when someone digs in" (the Trojan-horse quiet-depth principle applied to the TUI + queue). All code-grounded with root cause + acceptance criteria. Recommended dispositions:

1. BUG-619 (Medium) — aida tui lags navigating to PRs; fetch_prs() is a synchronous gh call per navigation (dashboard.rs:210/328). Want async load + refreshing-notice, never block the cursor. RECO: approve + queue implementer. [NOTE: already sent to you individually earlier — included here only for the complete picture; do not double-file.]

2. BUG-620 (Low) — aida tui tab still labeled "dialog"; should display "advisor" (canonical per TASK-586; dialog is the deprecated alias). Minimal fix is a one-line label change at dashboard.rs:42. RECO: /aida-fasttrack candidate (trivial, CI-only gate). Optional internal enum/field rename is a separate, back-compat-sensitive follow-up.

3. BUG-621 (Low) — aida queue "To empty this queue" footer self-contradicts: prints "needs you: ... nothing to do" for in-flight items (render_path_to_empty hardcodes the "needs you" prefix for the self-resolving bucket too, burndown.rs:1377). RECO: small fix, fasttrack/queue. Secondary note in the spec: "resolves through normal flow" assumes the item is actually being worked — In-Progress-without-lease drift would make it falsely reassuring; worth honoring that split.

4. STORY-689 (Medium) — aida tui: render the preview as markdown (tui-markdown) + color-code structured fields (themeable), instead of piping aida show stdout as raw text. Real feature with design captured + a 2-slice plan (Slice 1 markdown body; Slice 2 themeable field colors). RECO: NOT fasttrack — approve + decompose into the two slices, Slice 1 first.

Filed by the product seat (propose-only); disposition is yours.
